create_event_from_dict: create an Event instance from a dictionary using Event.from_dict with type and start fields
convert_event_to_dict: convert an Event object to a dictionary using the to_dict method for serialization
create_sound_event_and_read: create a Sound event with a filepath then call read to load audio data as a tensor
split_video_event_by_timepoints: split a Video event into smaller clips using _split with a list of timepoints
load_fmri_nifti_data: create an Fmri event with filepath and subject then call read to load a NIfTI image
